_comment: Runtime settings for the collectors. Edit these instead of the code.
user_agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
_pace_comment: Sequential requests only, randomised gap between them. Raising these makes runs slower but safer.
_cap_comment: Hard stop so a config mistake can never turn into a hammering loop.
_payload_comment: Keep the untouched JSON so a parser bug can be fixed without re-scraping.
_lang_comment: Lazada auto-translates search results. 'as_returned' keeps whatever the platform sends; 'force_thai' adds the Thai locale hints. See README.
_scope_comment: Which platforms the pipeline and dashboard include. A platform listed here is kept; anything else is left out of the processed tables so a partial history cannot distort day-over-day comparisons. Raw snapshots in data/raw are NEVER touched by this. Empty list means include everything.
